meta.title: Saving an email template with duplicate name returns validation error

steps.note: Open the prepared draft eRFX project on its create screen.
Navigate to the Technical stage where the contract template component is configured.

args.goal: On the Technical stage, open Edit for the 'Special condition of the contract' template component, modify the text to the updated special condition text, delete the requested line items, verify the Required and Not Required toggles work, click Save, and stop when the updated template fields are visibly saved.

steps.note: Perform and verify the buyer-side template editing interactions that have no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the Technical stage still displays the edited contract-template component after saving.
